critical_failures.title: Light Mode Completely Non-Functional
critical_failures.description: Despite multiple fix attempts, light mode remains broken with white borders around dark components
critical_failures.root_cause: CSS variable cascade issues and incomplete theme implementation
attempted_fixes: Added dark: classes to form elements
critical_failures.lesson: Visual validation is mandatory - code correctness ≠ visual correctness
critical_failures.prevention: Always test visual output in browser, not just code logic

critical_failures.title: Chat Too Far From Sidebar - Gap Spacing Issue
critical_failures.description: gap-6 (24px) created excessive visual separation between sidebar and chat
critical_failures.root_cause: Misunderstanding of Tailwind gap values and visual impact
attempted_fixes: Reduced gap from gap-6 to gap-3
Added debug panel for visual validation
critical_failures.impact: Poor space utilization on laptop screens
critical_failures.lesson: Small CSS changes can have major visual impact
critical_failures.prevention: Always measure actual pixel values in DevTools

development_patterns.title: Code Logic vs Visual Reality Disconnect
development_patterns.description: Multiple instances where code appeared correct but visual output was wrong
examples: Grid spans looked correct but gaps affected actual proportions
Theme classes present but not applying correctly
ARIA attributes correct but visual feedback missing
development_patterns.solution: Mandatory visual testing for every UI change
development_patterns.implementation: Open preview URL after every significant change

development_patterns.title: Dangerous Assumption-Based Development
development_patterns.description: Making changes based on assumptions rather than validation
examples: Assuming theme system works because CSS variables are defined
Assuming grid proportions based on column spans without considering gaps
Assuming component works because similar components work
development_patterns.implementation: Ask specific questions before implementing solutions

technical_learnings.title: Tailwind Gap Values Have Major Visual Impact
technical_learnings.lesson: gap-6 (24px) is too large for sidebar-chat separation
technical_learnings.recommendation: Use gap-2 or gap-3 for component separation

technical_learnings.title: CSS Variables Alone Insufficient for Reliable Theming

technical_details.problem: CSS variables not cascading properly to all components
technical_details.deployment_issues: Different behavior in development vs production

technical_learnings.lesson: Explicit dark: classes more reliable than CSS variables

technical_learnings.title: localStorage Theme Persistence Unreliable in Deployment
technical_learnings.lesson: Don't rely solely on localStorage for critical state
technical_learnings.solution: Force default theme with JavaScript override

accessibility_learnings.title: ARIA Attributes Essential for Screen Reader Support
accessibility_learnings.lesson: Accessibility is not optional - WCAG compliance improves UX for everyone
accessibility_learnings.validation: Test with screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver)

governance_learnings.title: Governance PR Template Mandatory for All Changes
governance_learnings.description: PR blocked due to missing governance template usage
governance_learnings.prevention: Always use governance template for PRs

governance_learnings.title: Systematic Merge Conflict Resolution Required
governance_learnings.description: Conflicts between main branch improvements and feature branch changes

approach.component_priority: Prefer themed components over raw HTML

governance_learnings.lesson: Conflict resolution requires systematic approach and documentation
governance_learnings.best_practice: Always document why specific changes were chosen

performance_learnings.title: Mobile Voice Performance Requires Specific Optimization
performance_learnings.lesson: Mobile devices need different voice processing parameters
performance_learnings.testing: Test on actual mobile devices, not just emulation

deployment_learnings.title: Cache-Busting Essential for Frontend Updates
deployment_learnings.description: Frontend changes not visible due to browser/CDN caching

technical_details.problem: Users see old version despite new deployment

deployment_learnings.prevention: Always verify changes in incognito/private browsing

deployment_learnings.title: SSH Key Authentication More Reliable Than Passwords
deployment_learnings.description: SSH password authentication can fail unexpectedly

technical_details.password_auth: Unreliable, can be disabled by server

deployment_learnings.lesson: Prefer SSH keys over password authentication
deployment_learnings.implementation: Generate and use SSH keys for all server access

anti_patterns.title: Code-Only Validation Without Visual Testing
anti_patterns.description: Assuming code correctness equals visual correctness
examples: Grid spans look correct in code but visual spacing is wrong
Theme classes present but not applying visually
Component props correct but rendering incorrectly
anti_patterns.why_dangerous: Users see the visual output, not the code
anti_patterns.solution: Always test visual output in browser
anti_patterns.prevention: Mandatory preview URL testing for UI changes

anti_patterns.title: Assumption-Based Problem Solving
anti_patterns.description: Making changes based on assumptions rather than understanding
examples: This should work based on similar components
The theme system must work because CSS variables are defined
Grid proportions should be correct based on column spans
anti_patterns.why_dangerous: Leads to repeated failures and technical debt
anti_patterns.prevention: Validate assumptions with testing and measurement

anti_patterns.title: Silent Problem Solving Without Communication
anti_patterns.description: Attempting to solve problems without asking for clarification
examples: Guessing what user wants instead of asking
anti_patterns.why_dangerous: Leads to solutions that don't meet actual needs

success_patterns.title: Slot-Based Development Approach
success_patterns.description: Focus on one improvement area at a time
success_patterns.implementation: Each PR targets specific slot (e.g., form-theme-system)
success_patterns.governance: Slot names in branch names and PR titles

success_patterns.title: Reusable Themed Component System
success_patterns.description: Standardized components with built-in theming and accessibility

success_patterns.title: Visual Evidence for All UI Changes
success_patterns.description: Require screenshots/videos for all UI-related PRs

debugging_methodologies.title: DevTools for Actual Pixel Value Measurement
debugging_methodologies.description: Use browser DevTools to measure actual rendered values

debugging_methodologies.title: Temporary Debug Panels for Layout Validation
debugging_methodologies.description: Add temporary debug information to validate layout parameters
debugging_methodologies.implementation: Fixed position panel showing current values

testing_strategies.title: Cross-Browser Theme Compatibility Testing
browsers: Firefox - Good support with some quirks
testing_approach: Test theme toggle in each browser

testing_strategies.title: Real Mobile Device Testing Required
testing_strategies.description: Emulation doesn't catch all mobile-specific issues

knowledge_transfer.title: Manifest System Critical for Knowledge Transfer
knowledge_transfer.maintenance: Update after every significant learning or failure

future_prevention_strategies.title: Implement Automated Visual Regression Testing
future_prevention_strategies.description: Prevent visual regressions through automated testing
future_prevention_strategies.coverage: All major UI components and layouts
